svg.title: HAIEC product capability architecture
svg.desc: Proposed source-qualified diagrams showing independent HAIEC capability families, evidence and action readiness, and user paths. Not a live system assessment.

g.text: 12 workflow families across multiple personas. Module-specific prerequisites; none is a universal onboarding gate.
Availability is per workflow, persona, organization, system, integration and evidence basis.
Configured ≠ qualified; policy approval ≠ deployment approval ≠ runtime enforcement; LogSense/demo ≠ production evaluation.
